title: Explicit scalar extension and normalized lift on the one-point module site
statement: Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings. Use the one-object bottom site and the tensor-presheaf construction of [def-pc-ring-hom-extension-shared-definitions], with the notation of [def-weil-pbc-ring-complex-cech-data]. Define $E_\varphi$ by the actual tensor presheaf $B\otimes_{A,\varphi}M$ followed by sheafification; its map on a morphism $f$ is the sheafification of $\mathrm{id}_B\otimes f$. This is an additive functor. Its extension to integer cochain complexes has terms $\operatorname{changeOfRings}(\varphi,P^n)$ and differential $\operatorname{changeOfRingsHom}(\varphi,P^n,d_P)$. On the bottom site the sheafification unit is invertible and identifies sections of $E_\varphi M$ with $B\otimes_{A,\varphi}M$. The extension/restriction adjunction extends any $\varphi$-semilinear map $f:M\to N$ to the unique $B$-linear map $E_\varphi M\to N$ sending $1\otimes x$ to $f(x)$. Applied degreewise to a semilinear cochain map, these lifts commute with differentials. For a family map $m_\varphi:K(A,I)\to K(B,J)$ and a cochain map $p:P\to K(A,I)$, denote by $\operatorname{ringComplexExtendAlong}$ the actual lifted map $E_\varphi P\to K(B,J)$; its value on $1\otimes x$ is $m_\varphi(p(x))$. The functor, section, chain, and normalization identities are proved in Lean.

proof.text: Construct scalar extension by tensor presheaves and sheafification and lift maps by the extension/restriction adjunction. In the public point-lift definition use Subsingleton.elim on the one-object site directly. In the morphism extensionality proof reuse the existing CategoryTheory.point_eq helper from the one-point Hom transport module, without restating it.
